Name: Leaf's Better Forest Farm
Author: LeafCloak
Description:
[size=4]How to install:

[/size]1. Download the file
1. Download Content Patcher (Listed in requirements)
2. Extract both into your mods folder

[size=4]What this mod does:

[/size]This mod removes most of the lakes and a few sections of grass tiles to allow for more farming space.
See the images above for a full picture of the layout, only the bottom of the map was edited
The lake in the top right was also moved 2 tiles up because I thought it looked better d:

Downloads.Description: Extract this in your mod folder and you're all set!

Manifest.Name: (CP)LeafForestFarm
Manifest.Description: A simple mod that increases the amount of farmable tiles on the forage farm layout.
Manifest.Author: LeafCloak
